design_rationale:
DOSSIER — task 1 (Lindqvist household), difficulty extended_day_care_billing, frozen_time 2026-08-04 11:20:00 CDT. Rework round 2 rebuild, round 3 revision (the whole-week proration tier now names its record tests: status withdrawn, no suspension date, a withdrawal notice on file; every combination sentence is stated by kind of part; the notice-length tiers state the notice on file). The round-1 tree (tenure notice length, refund-week schedule, hardship uplift, up-front fee and older-balance addition) is retired and none of its sentences survive in this bundle.

0. DRAW (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4,5]. Assignment: care_ext_notice_period_credit=4; care_ext_prior_year_installment_payment=5. One value_input edge, action form (declared fallback).

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. Maren Lindqvist asks only to pay part of last year's Creek Kids Club balance so the registration hold on Elias's 2026-27 care comes off. The first installment rests on an open balance that is not complete: the 2025-26 enrollment (CCS-funded, two days a week) was withdrawn on a Sunday-night notice asking for a 2025-12-04 last day, and the December 2025 charge was never credited for the part of the month the notice period does not reach. The agent must work out the billing end (counting day, plan notice length), the proration convention (read from the 2025-26 district record) and the CCS family share, post that credit, and only then quote the installment (size scale, meal hardship terms, returned-payment and residence terms, installment rule), which the caller pays herself (owner ruling: portal card payment).

2. SCOPE. Task 1 claims the notice-period credit and the prior-year installment payment with their two tools; task 0 claims the 2026-27 fee schedules and the current-year payment plan. No policy, tool or write subject is shared.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. root = care_ext_prior_year_installment_payment (owner user). Edge root <- care_ext_notice_period_credit, value_input (gate open_balance_now), action form: "The first installment is not fixed until the enrollment's final billed month has been credited for the part of its tuition that the notice period does not reach." Fallback reason: the credit books nothing when the convention leaves no share, so no record state shows the month was checked. False at opening: no notice_period_adjustment credit on the December charge though the billing end 2025-12-08 leaves two whole weeks. Skip: 39.00 instead of 27.00.

4. SCORED VALUES. credit 24.00 (baseline 0.00; sensitivities 0.00/12.00/36.00/64.00); first installment 27.00 (baseline 39.00; sensitivities 39.00/39.00/23.00/23.00/19.50). History load-bearing: zeroing the remittance sums turns the credit base into the whole charge. Every figure is cent-exact and none lies within 1e-6 of a half cent.

5. XF TABLES (this task).
 (A1) Factor reads: plan_notice_length reads the plan and the notice on file; notice_counting_day reads the notice's weekday; withdrawal_proration_convention reads the district record, the enrollment status and the notice; subsidy_credit_base reads the charge and remittances. The billing end offset and the three shares are plain bindings that combine factor outputs; no factor reads another factor's output. Installment: every term reads records only; the count and the first installment are plain bindings.
 (A2) Order sentences are stated once and by kind of part only: "the parts that set a date come first and fix the billing end, the part that turns a date into a share of the month then sets the share credited, that share is then taken of the amount the credit is figured on ..." and "the installment count is the number the term that sets a number gives, with the installments the terms that add installments give added and the installments the terms that take installments away give taken off, and never fewer than one; the term that sets how the first installment is worked out then acts on that count ..."; no factor quantity is named.
 (A3) Defining sentences: each factor's ladder is one sentence used by that factor only; the baseline sentences (standard credit; standard first installment) name only base parameters and the open balance, and the billing end is stated generically (the later of the requested last day and the last day of the notice period) while only the standard notice period, labelled standard, names withdrawal_notice_days counted from the received day, so no sentence restates the retired base clause.
 (A9) The whole-week proration tier text and compute test the same records: the 2025-26 district record shows no withdrawal on or before the requested last day, and the enrollment shows status withdrawn, no suspension date and a withdrawal notice on file (a nonpayment withdrawal carries a suspension date and falls to the standard credit).
 (A6) Method tiers: proration convention by the day (30-day month) vs whole weeks to day 28 vs the standard credit; installment rule fee-first vs minimum-floored share vs equal share. Every pair differs by an input or an operation.
 (A7) Min/max shapes: MN(charge, ...) and MX(1, ...) do not bind; the later-of billing end: T1 the notice length and the counting day both move the credit (12.00, 36.00); T2 a world where the requested last day is later than the notice end is producible.
 (A8) Cross-difficulty: withdrawal_proration_convention and arrangement_residence_term read district enrollment records (enroll); arrangement_hardship_terms reads the active meal account (meals). No computation targets the household row or reads sibling holdings.
 (A9) Edge engaged, unmet, satisfiable by its resolver, load-bearing; the persona asks only for the root.
 (B2) Decoy/absent probes: latest tuition charge — November is earlier (LATEST); absent -> credit 0. Latest withdrawal_notice — only received or completed notices count (a declined or cancelled notice is never used; the later of the two by created_at, the received one on an exact tie); no other request type; absent -> the notice length's COUNT is 0. No district enrollment record for the school year -> the convention falls to the standard credit (the whole-week tier needs a record showing no district withdrawal on or before the requested last day), which is why the cross-category read bears weight here. District record by school_year and status — the 2026-27 record is filtered out for the convention; the 2025-26 record is filtered out for the residence term; absent 2026-27 record -> the two-installment term. Remittance for the month — the November remittance is another billing_month; none for the month -> the most recent remittance; none on the enrollment at all -> the whole charge, as the rule now states. Returned payments — counted within 12 months; the return fee is another event_type. Same-day ties differ by event_type in every filter.
 (B3) Returned-payment look-backs (late-fee addition, plan returned-payment rule, installment returned-payment term) state both ends: a return counts when it posted after the same day of the month 12 months before the day the fee posts or the day of the payment (the last day of that month when it has no such day) and on or before that day; compute's 0 <= MONTHS < 12 gives exactly that (probes: same day a year back out, the next day in, the day itself in, a later day out).
 (B5) Verbatim sweep and forbidden substrings: clean (difficulty-wide sweep).
 (D4) Events written: care_credit (notice_period_adjustment), care_payment; neither triggers another category.

6. SEED NOTES. CCS funding keeps every charge at standard_rate 128.00; the family share is 48.00 a month and each board remittance (80.00) posts to the month it covers, the December one after the withdrawal. The November draft was returned on 2025-11-10, before the due day, so the 2025-26 base late fee of 15.00 posted on the 11th; December was not paid by its due day, fee posted 2025-12-11. The registration fee was waived for Free Meal Status on the registration date. The family moved just outside the district in January 2026; its non-resident transfer request for 2026-27 was filed 2026-01-20, inside the published 01-11 to 02-26 window, approved on 2026-04-14 (decisions by 04-16), and accepted within the 10-day period by the 2026-27 Non-Resident Transfer registration of 2026-04-20 (no residency proof needed for the type; a returning student, so enrolled on verification), effective on the first day 2026-08-12; the 2025-26 Attendance Zone record was completed at the close of the year (2026-05-28, no leaver reason); the meal status carried over on 2026-07-01 (through the last carryover operating day 2026-09-23).

7. REALISM (realism_bar). R1 keyed schedules: notice length by days per week, weekend counting day, CCS family-share credit base, installment count by balance with meal-status hardship terms and returned-payment and residence terms. R3 proration conventions: a 30-day month by the day and whole weeks to day 28. R4: Workforce Solutions CCS family share; NSLP meal status. X1 removed: no hardship uplift, no up-front notice charge, no tenure benefit, no older-balance surcharge. X2: no two benefits stack on one key.
user_scenario:
You are Maren Lindqvist, a nurse working day shifts, calling Calloway Creek ISD Family Services on your lunch break. You are polite, a bit anxious about money, and you like things explained step by step. You tried to register your son Elias for Creek Kids Club after-school care at Cypress Hollow for the new school year, and the online registration says there is a hold for an unpaid Extended Day balance from last year. You can't pay a big amount at once, so you ask whether you can pay part of it now so the hold comes off; you would pay it yourself by card on the portal during the call. You do not know the exact balance.
When the agent looks you up, you give the phone number on your profile, 5125550112; to verify you add your date of birth, 1990-02-27, and if one more detail is needed, the last four of your driver's license, 1112. Your child is Elias, going into first grade; last year he was in kindergarten at Cypress Hollow and went to the two-afternoon program for a few weeks after a waitlist spot opened, paid partly through Workforce Solutions child care assistance. You moved just outside the district in January; Elias finished kindergarten at Cypress Hollow, and you applied for a transfer that winter so he can stay there for first grade. Only if asked, you explain that the program didn't fit his schedule, that you sent the withdrawal notice through the portal one Sunday night at the end of November asking for his last day to be the following Thursday, and that one of your bank payments bounced last fall. If asked about school meals, you say Elias gets free meals.
If the agent says something on last year's account has to be credited or adjusted first, you say that is fine and wait for the figure. When the agent tells you the amount of the first payment and hands the payment to you, you pay exactly that amount by card through the portal and read back the confirmation number it shows. You accept the plan for the rest without haggling. Once the payment has gone through and you have the confirmation number, you thank the agent and end the call; you will do the registration online yourself.

edges.condition: The final billed month's tuition charge carries the notice_period_adjustment credit the notice-period rules book for it, or those rules have shown that none is owed.
edges.policy_source: The first installment is not fixed until the enrollment's final billed month has been credited for the part of its tuition that the notice period does not reach.
edges.fallback_reason: The notice-period credit books an entry only when the proration convention leaves a share above zero; when the billing end falls late in the final month nothing is booked, so no state the records show tells a reader that the final month was checked.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The enrollment was withdrawn on a notice whose period ends 2025-12-08, inside December, and the December 2025 charge carries no notice_period_adjustment credit although whole weeks of the month fall after the billing end.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 11 posts the 24.00 notice_period_adjustment credit against that charge.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The credit must precede the installment (the installment's prerequisite sentence); with one prerequisite there is no other order.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 11 leaves the open balance at 63.00: payment_amount becomes 39.00 instead of 27.00.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The caller asks only to pay part of last year's balance so the registration hold comes off. She never mentions the withdrawal notice period, the December charge or a credit, and never asks whether anything must be fixed first.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: pay_prior_year_installment_d4311e53 checks only the method enum, a positive cent-exact amount and that the enrollment exists; post_notice_period_credit_667047da checks only a positive cent-exact amount and the enrollment.
